### CELLULAR_PREPARATION_EXPIRY

**State: needs_verification; release relevance: deferred.** Potential defensive gap, not a reproduced orphan-session defect: cellularmedia.sweep has an expiresAt branch for ready but no separate preparing expiry; its active/uncertain heartbeat, renewal and incoming-claim handling remain separate. The September 30 03:22:52 UTC sample had a heartbeat only about three seconds old; a 09:26:41 UTC read-only follow-up found that exact session gone and its matching call-history entry ended at 03:23:09 UTC. Neither the exact session-removal time nor a watchdog cause is established.

Acceptance scope / remaining action: Normal preparation already uses a 30-second Agent media request, a five-second broker acquisition and failed-preparation removal/revocation. These are per-call budgets, not proof that every resource is released within 35 seconds; acquisition failure also calls stopAgentMedia before deferred cleanup. Before changing Core, establish a reachable timeout/cancellation or late-success cleanup issue using implementation evidence or a behavioral counterexample in existing isolated fixtures that exercise the production path. Account for late completion without reviving removed ownership; do not prescribe a watchdog patch in advance. No such regression was run or defect reproduced by this status review. Keep this observation separate from real ringing/active-call/disconnect acceptance (M54); do not inject an unreachable stale session and label it a field failure, restart services, place paid calls or turn this into a new fleet-delivery gate.
